name: Alchemist's Supplies
summary: Brew acids, alchemist's fire and simple reagents; identify potions and strange substances.

name: Brewer's Supplies
summary: Brew beer and ale, judge whether a drink is safe, and purify water.

name: Calligrapher's Supplies
summary: Write in fine script, spot forged handwriting and decode written ciphers.

name: Carpenter's Tools
summary: Build or repair wooden things: doors, barricades, carts, simple shelters.

name: Cartographer's Tools
summary: Draw accurate maps while you travel, read old maps and work out where you are.

name: Cobbler's Tools
summary: Make and repair shoes; read footprints and notice hidden compartments in boots.

name: Cook's Utensils
summary: Cook decent meals on the road; helps the party recover over a rest and spot bad food.

name: Glassblower's Tools
summary: Shape glass bottles, lenses and vials; judge where a piece of glass came from.

name: Jeweler's Tools
summary: Cut and set gems, appraise jewelry and spot fake stones.

name: Leatherworker's Tools
summary: Make and repair leather armor, bags and straps; judge hides.

name: Mason's Tools
summary: Work stone: repair walls, find weak points in masonry and secret passages.

name: Painter's Supplies
summary: Paint pictures and signs, copy art and spot forged paintings.

name: Potter's Tools
summary: Make clay pots and judge where pottery shards came from.

name: Smith's Tools
summary: Repair metal weapons and armor, and work iron at a forge.

name: Tinker's Tools
summary: Fix small gadgets and objects, and build simple contraptions.

name: Weaver's Tools
summary: Make and mend cloth, rope and clothing; spot a disguise's seams.

name: Woodcarver's Tools
summary: Carve wood: arrows, staves, small figures and repairs.

name: Dice Set
summary: Play dice games and tell when someone is cheating at them.

name: Dragonchess Set
summary: Play dragonchess, a long strategy game popular with nobles and scholars.

name: Playing Card Set
summary: Play card games and spot a marked deck or a cheat.

name: Three-Dragon Ante Set
summary: Play Three-Dragon Ante, a betting card game found in many taverns.

name: Bagpipes
summary: Loud wind instrument. Add proficiency when you perform with it.

name: Drum
summary: Percussion instrument. Add proficiency when you perform with it.

name: Dulcimer
summary: Stringed instrument you strike with hammers. Add proficiency when you perform with it.

name: Flute
summary: Simple wind instrument. Add proficiency when you perform with it.

name: Lute
summary: The classic bard instrument. Add proficiency when you perform with it.

name: Lyre
summary: Small handheld harp. Add proficiency when you perform with it.

name: Horn
summary: Brass horn, also good for signals. Add proficiency when you perform with it.

name: Pan Flute
summary: Set of reed pipes. Add proficiency when you perform with it.

name: Shawm
summary: Reedy wind instrument. Add proficiency when you perform with it.

name: Viol
summary: Bowed string instrument. Add proficiency when you perform with it.

name: Disguise Kit
summary: Makeup, dyes and props to change how you look. Add proficiency to checks to create a disguise.

name: Forgery Kit
summary: Inks, papers and seals to copy documents and signatures.

name: Herbalism Kit
summary: Find and use herbs; required to make antitoxin and potions of healing.

name: Navigator's Tools
summary: Plot a course at sea and find your position by the stars.

name: Poisoner's Kit
summary: Make and handle poisons safely, and identify them.

name: Thieves' Tools
summary: Lockpicks and small tools. Needed to pick locks and disarm traps.
